info.name: Campus Printing and Document Submission Management System Midterm
info.description: Isange Nelly, 27818. One request per requirement, named by its ID. Base URL is http://localhost:8081. A1 is the five entities and has no endpoint. Part B looks up students by last name and print requests by status or date. Part C finds operators by print service, free printers, unused services, and an operator's students. Part D blocks a past date and a second active request on the same day, and changes status, a print service, or the printer. Part E saves a payment only for a ready request. Part F counts requests by status and cancels one day except a ready request. The bonus shows the dashboard and one page of print requests.

request.description: CRUD for students, printers, print services, operators, and print requests. Save returns 201. An unknown id on get, update, or delete returns 404. The same paths are /api/print-services, /api/printers, /api/print-operators, /api/students, and /api/print-requests, each with /save, /all, /{id}, /update/{id}, and /delete/{id}.
Students with last name Isange, ignoring letter case, sorted by first name.
Print requests whose status is SUBMITTED, earliest date first.
Print requests from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31, both dates included, ordered by date.
Print operators who hold the Binding service. The name match ignores letter case.
Printers that no operator occupies, ordered by printer number. The seed returns printer 4.
Print services that no operator holds. The seed returns Lamination.
Each student who has a print request with Alice, listed once. An unknown operator id returns 404, The print operator with that id does not exist.
A past date returns 400, Print request date cannot be in the past. A second active request for the same operator on the same day returns 409. A saved request is always SUBMITTED.

Moves Document 10 from SUBMITTED to PROCESSING. A skipped step or a final status returns 400, Cannot change status from X to Y. An unknown id returns 404. Updating a request does not change its status.
Adds Lamination to Alice and keeps Black and White and Binding. Adding it again returns 409. A missing operator or service returns 404.
Moves Alice to printer 4. A taken printer returns 409. A missing printer number or operator returns 404.
Saves a payment for Document 1, which is READY. The paid date becomes today. A request that is not READY returns 400. A missing request returns 404.
Payments for student 27818, newest paid date first. An empty list means that student has none.
An unknown payment returns 404, The print payment with that id does not exist. Deleting a print request that still has a payment returns 409, That print request has print payments, delete them first.
One row for each status that has print requests, with its count.

Cancels Alice's requests on a day that has none, so the seed stays as it is and the reply is 0 print requests cancelled. A ready request on a real day is left ready. The paper example date is 2026-10-20.
Counts students, print operators, free printers, today's requests, submitted requests, and payments.
The first page of print requests, five at a time, newest request date first. The response includes the total pages and the total number of requests.
